test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 09 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is the value of (tan A-sin A)/(tan A+sin A)?
solution:
Given:

 (tan A-sin A)/(tan A+sin A)

Concept used:

1. tanα = sinα/cosα

2. secα = 1/cosα

Calculation:

According to the concept,

 (tan A-sin A)/(tan A+sin A)

⇒ (frac {sin A)/(cos A)-sin A}{frac {sin A}{cos A}+sin A}

⇒ (frac {1)/(cos A)-1}{frac {1}{cos A}+1} (Cancelling sin A from both numerator and denominator)

⇒ (sec A-1)/(sec A+1)

**∴ The value of (tan A-sin A)/(tan A+sin A) is (sec A-1)/(sec A+1).**
